project_type: Express.js backend API with SQLite (better-sqlite3) for a crypto mining app
build_system: npm with simple node start script
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/anotnigeia/server && node -e "require('./index.js')" (basic syntax check - no tests exist)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install in server/ to verify dependencies resolve. 2. Check that index.js can be parsed without syntax errors via node --check index.js. 3. Verify .env.example exists with all required vars documented.
environment_constraints: SQLite DB file is local. No Docker daemon available. Validation via node --check and npm install.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists. Follow existing code style (CommonJS, no semicolons in some places but generally uses them).
key_patterns: Single-file Express app with inline route handlers. Uses better-sqlite3 synchronous API. JWT for auth with Bearer token pattern. bcryptjs for password hashing. All routes prefixed with /api/.
directory_structure: Root is a Vite React frontend. /server/ contains the Express backend as a separate package with its own package.json.
